question: What exalted attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as a goal
A great accomplishment is the subject of becoming
Becoming dear to the yoginīs is the stated result
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
